name: Easy Pressure Cooker Spaghetti & Meatballs with Caesar Salad

instructions.primary_message: Set a 6-quart electric pressure cooker to sauté on HIGH.
While the pressure cooker heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion.
Once the pressure cooker insert is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, spaghetti seasoning, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until onion is soft, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp minced garlic
1 (43 g) pkg spaghetti seasoning mix
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add broth and marinara sauce to the pressure cooker, then stir to combine. Add meatballs and stir once more to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups chicken or vegetable broth
marinara sauce
1 (567 g) bag frozen homestyle meatballs, fully-cooked

instructions.primary_message: Use your hands to break the spaghetti in half, then add to the pressure cooker, arranging in a crisscross pattern. Gently press spaghetti into the sauce, but do not stir.

Wash and dry grape tomatoes, then arrange on top of the spaghetti. Lock lid and set pressure to cook on HIGH for 8 minutes. Once done, drape a clean towel over the vent, then manually release pressure.

Stir spaghetti, breaking up any clumps, then add additional marinara sauce. Stir once more to combine, then set aside to warm through and thicken slightly, 3-4 minutes. (Don't worry, any spaghetti that is clumped together will be cooked through.)
Meanwhile, place lettuce, dressing, and croutons from the salad kit in a large bowl. Toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (553 g) pkg Caesar chopped salad kit

instructions.primary_message: Divide spaghetti and meatballs between plates or bowls, then top with Parmesan. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
